title.value: Generating Character Descriptions for Automatic Summarization of Fiction
title.justification: The title of the paper is explicitly stated at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Generating Character Descriptions for Automatic Summarization of Fiction

analysis.description: The paper addresses the challenge of automatically summarizing fiction, with a focus on generating character descriptions as a key component of story summaries. The authors propose two models: an extractive method that ranks attributes found in the story text and an abstractive method that classifies into a list of pre-defined attributes. They find that the classification-based approach performs the best in predicting character descriptions, using a dataset collected from Wattpad, an online story sharing platform.

type.justification: The paper presents empirical research results, including the proposal of models for character description generation and the use of datasets and evaluation metrics to compare their performance.
type.quote: We propose two approaches to generate character descriptions, one based on ranking attributes found in the story text, the other based on classifying into a list of pre-defined attributes. We find that the classification-based approach performs the best in predicting character descriptions.
